description: Match own-account bank transfers. DUPLICATE-SAFE: skips transfers already journalized from the other side. DRY RUN by default returns a plan_handle enumerating the reviewed confirms/deletes; execute=true REQUIRES that handle and runs exactly the reviewed set. For one-sided transfers with 2+ possible targets, pass target_accounts_dimensions_id.

execute.description: Actually confirm matched pairs (default false = dry run)

max_date_gap.description: Maximum days between C and D transaction dates (default 1, max 31)

plan_handle.description: Execution-plan handle from the reviewed dry run. Required for execute=true.

target_accounts_dimensions_id.description: For one-sided transfers (no matching D/C pair), specify the target bank account dimension ID. Required when there are 3+ bank accounts and counterparty IBAN is missing.

name: reconcile_inter_account_transfers
title: Reconcile Inter-Account Transfers
